reference_status: chapter-scoped provisional group continuity; not approved

depiction_rules.notes: Use only as supporting groups in D029 stanzas 1–7. Distinguish the groups through costume, posture and palette, not monstrous anatomy.

visual_bible.devas: Distinct ordinary adult faces and natural two-arm, two-leg bodies; cream and muted blue/ochre garments, simple painted crowns only where clearly visible.
visual_bible.asuras: Distinct ordinary adult faces and natural two-arm, two-leg bodies; earthy maroon and ochre garments, restrained head ornaments. Avoid horns or grotesque caricature.
visual_bible.style: Sparse readable crowd clusters; each visible face and limb stays separate and attached. Matte mineral mural painting.
